Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Chronic anterolateral knee pain, no prior surgery. Associated with exercise.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal high-grade cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal high-grade cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Mucoid degeneration, otherwise intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Mild subcutaneous soft tissue edema involving the anterolateral soft tissues deep to the iliotibial band adjacent to the lateral femoral condyle. No tearing of the overlying IT band. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Findings suggestive of distal IT band friction syndrome.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Oblique undersurface tear at the posterior horn and body of medial meniscus with mild extrusion of the body.
Medial compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial thickness cartilage loss throughout the medial weightbearing surfaces.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness fissuring at the junction of the median ridge and medial patellar facet with subchondral cystic change. Full-thickness fissure at the lateral trochlea with subchondral cystic change.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Oblique undersurface tear at the posterior horn and body of medial meniscus with mild extrusion of the body.
2.	Medial and patellofemoral chondrosis.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Mukoide Degeneration des Innenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia und des Hinterhorns mit Auffaserung am freien Rand des Innenmeniskushinterhorns (Serie 5/ Image 23-25 ohne Nachweis einer Rissbildung. Gering Flüssigkeit angrenzend an das MCL sowie geringe Signalalterationen der posteromedialen Kapsel.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Mukoide Degeneration des Außenmeniskusvorderhorns, ansonstern intakter Außenmeniskus ohne Rissbildung. Parameniskale Zysten angrenzend an den Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL. 

Femoropatellares Gleitlager:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Fokaler bis über die subchondrale Grenzlamelle hinaus reichender Knorpeldefekt im oberen Patellafirst (Serie 6/ Image 19, Outerbridge Grad 4). Gegenüberliegend diskrete oberflächliche Chondropathie der Trochlea (Serie 4/ Image 15). Regelrechte Darstellung des Lig. patellae. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Mäßiger Gelenkerguss. Kleine Bakerzyste. Regelrechtes flow void in den miterfassten Gefäßen.

[DATE]: MR Knie Rechts 15ch AA: Klinische inlichtingen: Zie gescande aanvraag Diagnostische vraagstelling: Zie gescande aanvraag Bevindingen: Geen significante hydrops. Normale quadricepspees. Normale patellapees. Normaal vetplan van Hoffa. Intacte voorste kruisband. Intacte achterste kruisband. Degeneratieve horizontale scheur in de posterieure hoorn van de mediale meniscus. Intacte laterale meniscus. Intact mediaal collateraal ligament. Intact lateraal collateraal ligament. Parti ële dikte kraakbeenfissuren centraal op de crista patellae. Parti ële dikte kraakbeendefect inferieur trochleair met een diameter van 7\~mm. Geen majeure kraakbeendefecten lateraal femorotibiaal. Matige onregelmatige verdunning van het kraakbeen op het gewrichtsdragende gedeelte mediaal femorotibiaal met focaal volledige denudatie. Geen botoedeem. CONCLUSIE: - Graad 2 kraakbeenlijden patellofemoraal. - Graad 3 kraakbeenlijden mediaal femorotibiaal. - Degeneratieve horizontale scheur in de posterieure hoorn van de mediale meniscus.

Manje cistične promjene distalnog dijela femura te proksimalnog okrajka tibije u sklopu
degenerativnih promjena.
Manji subhondralni edem zglobnih tijela medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalog zgloba.
Reducirana debljina zglobnih hrskavica, izraženije u medijalnom kompartmentu femorotibijalnog
zgloba, te denudacija zglobne hrskavice lateralnog kompartmenta femoropatelarnog zgloba u
sklopu deg. promjena. Manji izljev suprapatelarno te u medijalnom i lateralnom recesusu.
Prednji križni ligament se ne prikazuje - totalna ruptura.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Hiperintenzitet stražnjeg roga mediijalnog meniska uz ekstruziju meniska pod MCL, stanje po
kompleksnoj rupturi.
Hiperintenzitet tijela i stražnjeg roga lateralnog meniska, stanje po horizontalnoj rupturi.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste, burzitis tetive m. semimembraosus. Deg. promjene tetivnog
hvatišta m. semiembranosus.
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba. Hondromalacija patelarne
hrskavice III stupnja.
Edem subkutanog mekog tkiva.

Opsežne gonartrotske promjene uz vidljivu kompletnu rupturu prednje križne sveze u srednjoj
trećini. Održana je stražnja križna sveza.
Kosa ruptura stražnjeg roga lateralnog meniska na prijelazu prema stražnjem korijenu.
Kompleksna ruptura trupa i stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska sa ekstruzijom i flapom meniska
pod medijalni kolateralni ligament prema kaudalno te polilobuliranim ganglion cistama
parameniscealno.
Kolateralni ligamenti su održani, lateralni blaže degenerativno promijenjen, medijalni distendiran
uslijed opisane ekstruzije meniska i opisanih ganglion cisti.
U sklopu gonartroze potpuna denudacija hrskavica medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog
zgloba te stanjenje i hondromalacija 2. - 3. stupnja lateralnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog
zgloba. Zone koštanog edema zglobnih tijela medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba.
U području hvatišta prednje križne sveze za interkondilarnu eminenciju interosalne ganglion
ciste u sklopu degenerativnih promjena.
Distenzija iliotibijalnog trakta.
Tetiva muskulusa popliteusa održana uz blaže tendinopatiju promjene. Održane su tetive PES
anserinus.
Hondromalacija 1. - 2. stupnja trohlearne i patelarne hrskavice.
Baker cista promjera 23X9 mm.
Održana je tetiva kvadricepsa i ligament patele. Umjeren izljev u koljenskom zglobu.
Atrofija m. vastus medialis i m. semimembranosus GC 2-3.

Vidi se opsežan koštani edem i multipli linearni hipointenziteti na T1 sekvenci uz prekide kortikalne kosti- nalaz odgovara multifragmentarnoj frakturi glave fibule. Vide se manji areali koštanog edema lateralnog kondila femura i lateralnog platoa tibije u stražnjem dijelu sa blazom denivelacijom u podrucju tibije (stanje po frakturi?). 
Femoralna i tibijalna zglobna hrskavica je jednoliko stanjena sa fokalnim hondralnim defektima nepune debljine medijalnog kondila femura.
Umjeren zglobni izljev sa zavlačenjem u sve zglobne recesuse. Difuzni cirkumferentni edem subkutanog masnog tkiva. 
Kompletna ruptura prednje i stražnje križne sveze. 
Vidi se putpuna ruptura medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta na proksimalnom hvatištu i parcijalna ruptura visokog stupnja fibularnog kolateralnog također uz proksimalno hvatište uz održan integritet tetive biceps femorisa i iliotibijalnog traktusa.
Medijalni menisk bez znakova rupture.U podrucju straznjeg roga lateralnog meniska suspektna je ruptura.
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste. Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba. Vidi se subtotalno stanjenje patelarne hrskavice apeksa i lateralne fasete u gornjem polu s fokalnom denudacijom i koštanim edemom (hondromalacijska lezija IV. stupnja).  Znakovi OA FT i FP zglobova.

Findings: No significant knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild patellofemoral dysplasia. T T T G distance is of normal appearance. The patella lies in a mildly lateralized position. There is evidence of focal degeneration of the medial patellar facet articular cartilage with mild underlying bony change. Normal trochlear articular cartilage.  The tibiofemoral articular cartilage is normal.  Conclusion: Focal medial patellar articular cartilage degeneration as described. No meniscal tear.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Condromalacia.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteración de señal difusa de la médula ósea. Pequeño ganglión intraóseo de 7 mm en el
margen medial del platillo tibial lateral.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales continuos.
Alteración de señal y leve extrusión meniscal medial con rotura degenerativa compleja de rasgo
principal horizontal que compromete cuerpo, cuerno posterior y en menor medida cuerno anterior.
Edema de las partes blandas para meniscales.
Menisco lateral de morfología conservada con fibrilación del borde libre del cuerpo y alteración de
señal del cuerno anterior y cuerno posterior que no cumple criterios de rotura.
Cartílago de los compartimentos femorotibiales con alteración de señal, superficie irregular y
defectos de espesor parcial mayores y menores al 50%. Destaca foco de condropatía profunda
con edema óseo subyacente en el aspecto posterior de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial.
Cartílago patelofemoral con alteración de señal, superficie irregular y defectos parciales menores
al 50%.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales. Leve engrosamiento y alteración de señal del tendón
rotuliano en su inserción distal.
Restantes tendones regionales de espesor y señal conservados.
Leve derrame articular. No se observa quiste de Baker.
Planos musculares de trofismo y señal conservados.
Impresión:
Rotura degenerativa compleja con maceración y extrusión del menisco medial. Edema de las
partes blandas para meniscales asociado.
Fibrilación del borde libre del cuerpo del menisco lateral.
Condropatía femorotibial grado 2-3 con foco grado 4 en el aspecto posterior de la zona de carga
del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía patelofemoral grado 2.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales.
Tendinopatía rotuliana distal.
Leve derrame articular
